scope: Phase C fixed read-only deployed-source tools, task-bound evidence/proposals/structural review, inert disabled draft contract, dashboard integration and conservative Preview documentation build skip.
riskAnalysis: Critical tool/evidence/delegation boundaries remain owner/workspace scoped in existing CAS journal. No network, provider, shell or writer is introduced. Source-only facts do not establish rendered defects, independent human review or acceptance.

threatModel.assets: Owner identity, workspace records, immutable QA and pilot history, existing spending ledger and cancellation authority.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Untrusted dashboard to fresh workspace-owner policy; scoped source ledger to canonical report; Redis CAS to fenced task and incident state; response readback to browser generations.
threatModel.abuseCases: Traversal/symlink/private files, recognizable secrets, source drift/substitution, forged task/reviewer/tool identity, stale release/fence, cancellation, ambiguous DAGs, rehashed provenance, draft write/publish flags and unsafe build skipping.
threatModel.mitigations: Exact literal4file profile, single screened source snapshot plus locked hashes, task-bound receipts/dependency canonical checks, existing fresh owner/CAS/fences/leases, unresolved substantive review, inert workspace descriptor and unknown-state-build gate.

rollback: Keep paid disabled/no approvals. Revert only Phase B feature source and redeploy disabled Preview; preserve separate journal history, original ledger/holds, central revocation, main and Production.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Actual service/API/UI reject malformed envelopes, corrupt task records and fabricated authority; no hidden repairs.
negativePaths.stale-state: Exact plan/task revisions, source snapshot and current release guards; UI discards older revisions.
negativePaths.concurrency: Existing Redis Lua CAS enforces unique create/claim, fenced completion, and cancellation racing publication.
negativePaths.cancellation: Owner cancellation and internal emergency stop reserve cleanup slots/bytes; original completed evidence remains.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: Lost committed internal claim yields visible lease expiry and one bounded owner-requested recovery; no process/provider executor added.
negativePaths.api-outage: Redis read/CAS failures deny execution; unknown delivery retains exact scoped idempotency key, no automatic retry.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Preview-only fresh session/member/workspace owner, worker/nonowner/CSRF/Production negatives and workspace-isolated journals.
negativePaths.spending-limit: New module has no provider transport, credential path or reservation writer; original fifteen-dollar ledger bytes stay unchanged.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Original attempt/history preserved, stale fences cannot publish, dependent tasks await verified reports and expired/cancelled work cannot recover.

defects.rootCause: Separate source reads could mislabel excerpts; ambiguous predecessors passed admission; self-consistent hashes alone omitted downstream provenance checks; incomplete UI selection could poison uncertain-create journal.
defects.detectionGap: New tool boundary required request-faithful independent negative testing beyond prior deterministic-report tests.
defects.regression: Actual service/API/UI and curated source tests cover source hashes, exactly one predecessor, canonical provenance, malformed paths/bytes, no premature journal, cancellation/lease/source races and forged review/write descriptors.
defects.historicalPrevention: Current negatives reject identified counterexamples before tool result acceptance; no paid transport is reachable.

proactiveReview.architecture: Extend existing authenticated broker, owner policy and Redis CAS; separate scoped internal journal cannot mutate paid execution/spending records.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Node builtins and current browser only, existing KV client and static dashboard; no new provider/model/package credentials.
proactiveReview.threats: Tenant projection leaks, forged authority, stale state, dependency loops, cancellation races and corrupted receipt evidence.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Observe storage only as of real read; provider unknown; expired tasks visible; reserve bounded cleanup audit/bytes; no auto retry.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Actual service source/CAS hooks, shipped UI delayed fetch promises, production/owner denial, disposable real Redis integration.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate Engineering Auditor and QA inspect actual changed source and add negative-path tests; corrections require refreshed lock and frozen STRICT.
proactiveReview.recovery: One owner-requested zero-provider retry within original deadline/release; cancellation, original receipts, independent QA and uncertainty are never overwritten.
proactiveReview.readiness: Targeted tests plus frozen full STRICT, real Redis CI, CodeQL, exact READY source/alias and authenticated owner workflow; new AI accuracy and tool autonomy remain unverified.
